speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you are experiencing postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness. To help me understand the severity, how many days postpartum are you, and have you noticed any foul-smelling discharge from your vagina?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometritis with potential urinary retention or ileus. Given the risk of sepsis and the prolonged labor, immediate assessment of the uterus for retained products and evaluation of the bladder are critical. Please proceed to check for fever and perform a pelvic exam to assess uterine firmness and discharge. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CRP, Urinalysis, Urine Culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound.
